data_facts_with_para.paragraph: In Sydney, the median house price is forecast to rise 7 per cent to $1.83 million, a jump of $112,000 — “more than the national average annual salary,” according to the report.

facts.fact_content: The median house price in Sydney is forecast to rise 7 per cent.
The median house price in Sydney is forecast to be $1.83 million.
The median house price in Sydney is forecast to jump by $112,000.
